ModMetaData.name: Psychic Augmentics
ModMetaData.author: Nidelese
ModMetaData.description:
Experimental eltex implants that channel psychic sensitivity into raw offensive power. Higher psychic sensitivity means more damage, tighter accuracy, faster fire rate, and shorter aim time — scaling without limit, but with diminishing returns.
Requires Vanilla Psycasts Expanded for eltex.
